# TRMNL Framework 3.3.1

Pinned from https://trmnl.com/framework/releases and the sources/checksums in `manifest.json`.
CSS/JavaScript are served through `/trmnl-framework/3.3.1/plugins.{css,js}` with gzip encoding and immutable caching.
Fonts are bundled so device rendering does not depend on the upstream asset server.
The CSS has only its `/fonts/` URLs rewritten to this version's local font directory.
Update the version, asset allowlists, and manifest together after rendering regression checks.
